concept.title: Information reported after claimant’s reports have been processed

conbody.p: When a client comes forward to correct previously provided information or provide previously omitted information, the agent determines if the information can be considered an error correction, or if it must be referred to Integrity to be considered under the voluntary disclosure policy.

The voluntary disclosure policy may apply if the client is aware that misinformation resulted in an inappropriate payment of benefits and is attempting to correct this situation. Unless specified otherwise, it is presumed that in providing the information, the client is in agreement that benefits were not payable.

To determine if the new information can be considered an error correction or must be referred to Integrity, the agent refers to Determining if an issue must be referred to Integrity . Determining if an issue must be referred to Integrity
